criteria.notes: Safety readiness results: completion, average score, pass rate and perfect-score counts, a latest-submissions table, and a score distribution panel.
Paired analytics concept retained alongside the questionnaire: same brand block and red accent, aggregate view rather than prompt view.
Reads as the results half of a purpose-built pair; the distribution panel and per-participant score column are specific to the questionnaire it aggregates.
Metric values dominate their tiles; submission rows and distribution labels sit at their intended roles.
The light compact scenario preserves metric, pass and fail colour separation against the pale field.
Long-title and corporate-ids scenarios keep the board title and participant identifiers complete rather than ellipsizing them.

Metric row, table and distribution panel divide the surface at both sizes; reduced row counts stay balanced and the empty state substitutes a centred message. The empty state now passes the shared empty-state conformance suite: non-blank, identity retained, message legible at room distance, not orphaned against the top edge.
Brand mark, distribution bars and status chips render crisply at 1366x768 and 1920x1080; no raster media involved.
Deliberately shares identity with the questionnaire it pairs with, which is the point of the pair, while its aggregate structure is not duplicated elsewhere.
